statement: Let n = len(nums). For each integer i with 0 <= i < n define: P(i) = sum_{j=0}^{i} nums[j]; Q(i) = sum_{j=i+1}^{n-1} nums[j] (the empty sum is 0); A(i) = P(i) div (i+1); B(i) = if i < n-1 then Q(i) div (n-1-i) else 0; D(i) = |A(i) - B(i)|. The function returns a result r such that 0 <= r < n, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, D(r) <= D(i), and for every i with 0 <= i < r, D(i) > D(r).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100000 and for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums), 0 <= nums[j] <= 100000.
